study.question: Which supplied feature-source gradient paths cause the observed click/auxiliary tradeoff in fixed compressed UF histories? Can auxiliary context learning restore useful auxiliary information while target/history embeddings remain click-owned, with no extra capacity or inference cost?
study.hypothesis: Observation: with scorer gradients blocked, allowing all auxiliary embedding gradients (g2-r0003-scorer_only) gives click AUC 0.65832249 and auxiliary mean AUC 0.85909506; blocking them all (g2-r0003-both_blocked) gives click AUC 0.66004065 and auxiliary mean 0.64761936. The latter is a click improvement with a severe multitask failure. Provisional mechanism: auxiliary learning needs supplied user/context embeddings, while auxiliary target/history-item/action updates may account for much of the click penalty. Separate those backward paths at a fixed 30-summary forward operator to seek a compromise. These sources are not yet causally localized, and the proposed direction may fail.

nearest_work.difference: Archived primary text lines 56-126 verifies target-conditioned local activation; lines 317-335 describes Dice train/inference statistics. We inherit the adapted local scorer, not original DIN results or an exact reproduction; novelty of source-selective stop-gradient is unverified.

Pinned implementation lines 123-169 uses task-masked projected sequence hubs and layerwise task interactions; inspected with benchmark section 2.3. Here fixed arithmetic temporal/feedback summaries retain one shared scorer; only auxiliary backward paths by source change. INFNet original paper is provenance-only in the registry, so no original-paper priority or equivalence claim.

Pinned lines 55-114 reveal per-feature embedding modules and optional table sharing. Gating output paths rather than copying/freezing whole tables adds zero parameters. Shared target/history field uses remain grouped; cross-source alias audit is still a host prerequisite.

Available primary benchmark method descriptions distinguish stacked and layerwise interaction, including INFNet, HiFormer, EST and TokenFormer. This is an attribution continuation under inherited compression, not a new unified architecture or a paper-level novelty claim.

study.proposed_difference: Replace the previous all-or-nothing auxiliary embedding stop-gradient with independent context and item-source switches. Context governs the supplied non-item/non-action vector. Item governs both the current target-item vector and compressed historical item/action vectors. Auxiliary scorer parameter gradients stay blocked. Four standalone cells form a complete 2x2 with identical module construction, initialized weights, arithmetic forward values, buffers and inference; neither and both check the two previous endpoint operators. This is targeted mechanism attribution, not additional learned routing, added information, a novel compression method or a verified new architecture.
predictions: At identical weights and mode, all four cells must produce equal probabilities, masks and summary counts. Context/item switches affect only training gradients, with no change in expected 32,060,453 parameters (31,793,216 embedding; 267,237 dense) on the frozen feature map.

Directional prediction: context_only restores auxiliary mean AUC above neither; preregistered practical retention target is auxiliary mean >=0.84 with all three auxiliary AUCs >=0.80. These thresholds judge the proposed compromise and do not replace click AUC selection.

Directional prediction: context_only has better click AUC than both. A useful compromise additionally requires click AUC >= neither - 0.0005. Failure of that tolerance rejects click retention for this implementation even if auxiliary quality improves.
The two context and two item contrasts, and their outcome interaction, distinguish which source paths drive the tradeoff. No assumed interaction sign; report each metric separately.

Report all four AUC/Logloss values, primary click selection, auxiliary-only mean, sample/positive/negative counts and existing fixed history bins. Empty-history results are exploratory (6,444 samples; 427 positives) and cannot alone identify a history mechanism. Measure cost; training backward work can differ even with identical inference.
falsifiers: If context_only fails to restore auxiliary quality or loses more than 0.0005 click AUC versus neither, the proposed practical compromise is unsupported. If item_only dominates it, revise the source-location hypothesis rather than discarding the observation.

If restoring context is no better than restoring item gradients under matched controls, the proposed special role of context learning is not supported. Recovery can instead depend on target/history/action features or their interaction.

Any forward/initialization mismatch, incorrect source-gradient zeros, auxiliary updates into shared scorer parameters, persistent auxiliary BN updates, masked-history sensitivity, or access to target action/current labels invalidates a gradient-only interpretation before scoring.
If endpoint checks disagree materially with previous operators under the same state/seed and recipe, diagnose implementation or numerical drift; do not pool the results as matched evidence.
No actual gradient-angle measurement is available, so improved AUC cannot establish gradient opposition. One seed and no withheld outcomes leave generalization and repeatability unresolved.
alternative_explanations: Context is the entire supplied non-item/non-action group, not a raw user ID and not one feature; item group combines tied target/history field uses and historical action. This cannot distinguish target gradients from history gradients or individual fields.
FeatureEmbeddingDict supports shared tables. Host must audit aliases across groups before interpreting table ownership; without that audit conclusions are only about computational gradient paths.
Removing auxiliary gradients changes Adagrad accumulators and can change future shared values; effects do not by themselves prove negative gradient cosine or a compression-specific conflict.
Fixed Dice batch statistics, dense clipping, single-pass optimization and the one seed can influence learned trajectories. No independence is claimed for same-seed endpoint replays.

Feedback histories can help auxiliary prediction because the benchmark labels use same-user/category/brand 24h matching; observed benefits need not imply impression-specific conversion prediction or production-safe feedback maturity.

Original target-match compression was worse than rotated/uniform references; later feedback stratification helped auxiliary tasks but harmed click. These trajectories argue against assuming finer semantic compression is automatically better.

With all source gradients blocked auxiliary towers learn from click-trained embeddings; the auxiliary collapse can be representation undertraining rather than insufficient compressed information. Context restoration tests one route, not every possible remedy.

cost_plan.estimate_ref: g2-r0003-both_blocked wall 314.30s, g2-r0003-scorer_only 313.83s, related gradient cells 313.99-319.91s; frozen runtime conservative estimated unit 481.35s and trial cap 1203.37s. Expected four-cell cost about 1,280s; reserve 1,926s at the runtime unit estimate and <=4,814s at four caps, excluding preparation. Context reports 164,371.84s remaining; elapsed preparation and all checks remain charged.
cost_plan.attribution_reserve: Reserve 10,000s for host numerical preflight, endpoint/operator checks, the full 2x2 and any justified diagnostic failure. Before training: instantiate cells under identical seeds/state; verify exact parameter/state names and counts; same-weight FP32 and BF16 train/eval probability parity; mask perturbation and zero-history stability; current-action invariance; four-task output bounds/shapes; auxiliary-only backward gives zero scorer-parameter gradients in every cell and zero gradient through each blocked representation, while allowed nondegenerate source paths and auxiliary towers remain differentiable; click-only gradients identical across cells; primary Dice buffers update once and auxiliary buffers never persist; inspect cross-source table aliases and test tied target/history accumulation; verify torch.func support. Numerical tolerances FP32 max abs 1e-6, BF16 2e-3 for parity, with exact expected zero/None gradients. Preserve all failed receipts. Same-seed endpoint replays are consistency checks only. If useful, reserve an additional 12,000s for two further paired seeds of the chosen candidate and closest controls (target three seeds total), via the authorized host interface in a later phase; never change the current frozen seed from model config.
cost_plan.assessment_reserve: Keep at least 8,000s unused for any later frozen final comparison/withheld assessment and failures. No held-out command or feedback is authorized now; freeze code/config/checkpoint hashes, candidates, baseline, nearest controls, ablations and seeds before any such request. Preparation cannot generate checkpoints or independently reverify absent raw parquet files.
cost_plan.stop_rule: Do not train or install in this preparation phase. Submit only source modules and proposal. Host must refuse numerical failures or visibility/ownership violations; do not silently alter the frozen recipe. Every calibration, replay, failure and retry counts; no automatic duplicate assessment after an unknown state. Stop at the unchanged deadline/trial cap or when no useful full matched unit plus the reserves fits; never raise limits. Negative auxiliary or click results remain recorded.
